From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor registration + draft MSA redlines

Thanks for the thread and the attachments. I reviewed MSA_Redline_v3.pdf and left comments on the PDF (redlines). Two substantive items from Legal: 

1) Section 6 (Data retention): the proposed 7-year retention is broader than our standard; we can accept a 3-year retention with a carve for regulatory holds. Proposed counter-language: 

"Provider will retain Customer Data for a period of three (3) years following termination, except where longer retention is required by applicable law or regulatory obligation. Provider will provide reasonable access to audit logs necessary to demonstrate compliance with the Service Agreement upon written request and subject to a mutually agreed redaction process to protect other customers' data."

Please let us know if MedSupplyCo has a regulatory requirement mandating 7 years (specify statute).

2) Audit access / SOC 2: we can provide on-demand export of audit logs and a SOC 2 report. For SOC 2 evidence requests that require on-site inspection or extended data export, we typically handle via a statement of work (SOW) or an audit support addendum.

Operational ask: for PO mapping we need the Coupa export you use for your ERP. Marissa, can you provide our Enablement team with the sample Coupa punchout payload or a sandbox account? Elena, if you can share the PO_Mapping_Coupa.xlsx with the ERP column mapping, that'll let us confirm EDI/hosted API mapping fields.

I also dropped a suggested redline for Section 9 (Indemnity limits) — see page 7. If MedSupplyCo needs different limits for regulated medical suppliers, please flag the specific regs and we'll loop Exec Sales for credit/limit approval.

DocuSign link for a clean Order Form (no redlines) is below; we can prepare a clean OF and then attach the agreed MSA redline package once legal signs off: https://docusign.com/ordering/DocuSignLink-OrderForm-78345

- Dev (Legal Counsel)
